messages:
Maria: Heads-up — we’re doing a phased/"slice" rollout for model-serving v2.2 today starting 15:00 PT. Hosted + Dedicated. Need smoke checkers, rollback owner, and someone to watch alerts.
Sam: I can handle smoke checks 15:00–16:00 PT (prod access). I’ll validate /health, 95p latency, token QPS and run a few synth requests.
Ajay: Quick question — what’s the percent ramp cadence?
Maria: Plan (tentative):
- 1% for 10m (initial sanity)
- 5% for 20m
- 25% for 30m
- 60% for 30m
- 100% if all green
Wait conditions between steps: no errors >0.5% sustained for 10m, 95p latency < 350ms, regression tests pass. Immediate rollback if any hard alerts.
Chen: Which cohorts are in each slice? want to exclude legacy customers + a/b tests.
Maria: Cohorts: internal -> opt-in beta -> small business -> enterprise. We’ll route via tags: `canary-internal`, `canary-beta`, `canary-smb`, `canary-enterprise`. Legacy customers excluded via routing rule.
Ajay: How are we validating model outputs? I’ll run the regression harness against the nudge set at 1% and again at 5%. Command I’ll use:```
./scripts/eval_canary.sh --env=prod --cohort=canary-internal --output=reports/1pct.json
```
Maria: Nice. Also run the quick diff for hallucination/regression: `python3 tools/diff_checks.py reports/1pct.json baseline.json`
Sam: Checklist for smoke:
- curl https://model-hosting.prod/health -> status=ok
- spot-check 10 requests (edge cases)
- check dashboards: tokens/sec, 5xx rate, latency 95p
- confirm no new rate-limit errors in API gateway
I’ll paste results in this thread.
Sarah: I’ll own rollback if needed and stay on call until 16:45 PT. Rollback command:```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/model-serving --to-revision=<prev_rev>
# or use Console -> Deployments -> model-serving -> Rollback
```
Maria: @Sarah thanks. If you trigger rollback, also create a short postmortem and notify #incidents.
deploy-bot: Deployment job queued: redwood-deploy/v2.2 -> canary-internal (job id: 42)
deploy-bot: Started rollout at 1776000320 -> applying routing tag `canary-internal` to 1% of traffic
deploy-bot: Canary 1% complete @1776000420 — metrics snapshot: error_rate=0.12%, 95p_latency=320ms, token_qps=540. Regression job kicked by Ajay (job id: eval-987).
Sam: Initial smoke looks stable from my side (no 5xx, latency within expected). Proceed to 5% in 2m unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:
Ajay: Kicked regression job; ETA ~6m. /cc @Maria
Chen: Confirming routing exclusions worked — legacy tag not receiving traffic.
Maria: OK moving to 5% now. I’ll post step updates here. If anyone sees >0.5% error or latency spike >400ms, call rollback.
Sarah: I’ll be ready. If I don’t respond in 2m after an alert, assume I’m escalating and someone else should hit rollback.
Sam: Noted. I’ll keep checking dashboards and post raw metrics every step.
Maria: Thanks team. Will update when we hit 25%.
